name: Creaky Floorboards
tagline: Two retired ladies. One microphone. Zero correct answers.
notes: One episode plays between each week of Lukey's story (~30 seconds read aloud, ~85 words). Lines are 'Speaker: text'; *...* lines are sound cues.

ep1.title: Episode 1: The Heartbreak Lane Hauntings
lines: *Theme music: a creaky door, then a kazoo.*
Bev: Welcome back to Creaky Floorboards! I'm Bev.
Trish: And I'm Trish. We investigate the mysteries the police were too busy to care about.
Bev: This week: 12 Heartbreak Lane. Condemned! Leaky! And some young flipper just bought it.
Trish: Neighbors report dripping sounds. At night. In a PATTERN.
Bev: My theory? A mermaid. Lives in the plumbing. Lures homeowners with song.
Trish: Bev, that's not a theory. That's a Disney movie.
Bev: Disney based it on SOMETHING, Trish.
Trish: Next week, we dig into the history of the house. Stay creaky!

ep2.title: Episode 2: Who Was the Man in the Short Shorts?
lines: *Theme music: a creaky door, then a kazoo.*
Trish: Big news, listeners. We went to the library.
Bev: On purpose!
Trish: Microfiche. 1987. A man died at 12 Heartbreak Lane. A local swim coach.
Bev: And I found his photo in the town paper. Gorgeous mullet. And the shorts, Trish. The SHORTS.
Trish: Bev. Focus.
Bev: I am focused. I am extremely focused on the shorts.
Trish: The paper just says 'household accident.' Which is exactly what they'd say if it was a mermaid.
Bev: Thank you! Next week: an exclusive interview with an eyewitness. Stay creaky!

ep3.title: Episode 3: The Birthday Party Mystery
lines: *Theme music: a creaky door, then a kazoo.*
Bev: This week, an exclusive. We tracked down a guest from that fateful party in 1987.
Trish: A professional entertainer. Please welcome... Mr. Giggles.
Mr. Giggles: *honk honk* Hi, ladies.
Bev: Mr. Giggles, what do you remember?
Mr. Giggles: Nicest dad I ever worked a party for. Terrible with a wrench. Sink starts leaking, he goes 'Two seconds, buddy!' and dives under there. And that was that.
Mr. Giggles: Kid blew out his candles anyway. Brave little guy.
Trish: That's... actually really sad, Mr. Giggles.
Mr. Giggles: Also, he owed me twenty bucks.
Bev: Next week, we SOLVE it. Stay creaky.

ep4.title: Episode 4: Solved?!
lines: *Theme music: a creaky door, a kazoo, and this week, a dramatic gong.*
Trish: Listeners, we're LIVE from the front porch of 12 Heartbreak Lane. And we have solved the case.
Bev: It was the mob.
Trish: It was the MOB.
Bev: Think about it. A plumber's wrench? Classic mob weapon.
Trish: And Mr. Giggles? Clearly an informant. That honk was code.
Bev: The new owner just laughed and said the house 'passed inspection.' Which is EXACTLY what the mob would want us to—
*CRASH. A coffee mug slides off the porch railing and lands directly on the microphone.*
Bev: ...Trish, did you knock that over?
Trish: I didn't touch it.
Bev: ...Stay creaky, everybody.
